info.syllabusName: Dung sai và kỹ thuật đo (Tolerance and Measurement Techniques)
info.description:
The student will learn the fundamentals of Geometric Tolerancing, according to ANSI
standards. Skill will be developed in both the interpretation and application of
Geometric Tolerancing to engineering drawings
